summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 50 yen per share from 42 yen; year-end dividend guidance increased to 50 yen, bringing full-year dividend to 100 yen per share, up 23 yen from prior fiscal year, following upward revision of earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Modification of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Yondenko Corporation announced an increase in dividend guidance for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, following an upward revision of earnings forecasts. The interim dividend per share was raised to 50 yen from the previously announced 42 yen, with a record date of September 30, 2026. The year-end dividend per share forecast was also revised upward to 50 yen. As a result, the total annual dividend per share reaches 100 yen, an increase of 23 yen compared to the prior fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, when dividends totaled 77 yen per share.

The company revised earnings upward due to favorable construction progress through the second quarter and current status of ongoing projects. Operating profit guidance for fiscal 2027 was increased from 9.4 billion yen to 11.0 billion yen, net income attributable to parent company from 6.6 billion yen to 7.9 billion yen, and earnings per share from 139.39 yen to 166.85 yen.

The dividend increase reflects the shareholder return policy set out in the company's Medium-term Management Guidance 2030, announced in January 2026, which aims to improve return on equity and optimize capital composition. The interim dividend payment date is scheduled for November 30, 2026.
